journey.name: terms of use
journey.description: The onboarding terms show the approved USDT wording, remain scrollable through the final clause, and keep the existing Continue flow. Use an English fresh installation on a test device that has not completed onboarding. No wallet, funds or backend are required.

actions.action: Launch Bitkit
Verify the terms screen shows "Effective date: October 20, 2026"
Scroll the terms until the "Blocktank Connection" definition in section 2.1.7 is visible
Verify the whole defined-term name is bold, not only its opening quotation mark
Scroll the terms until the "USDT" definition in section 2.1.49 is visible
Verify the definition includes "USDT0 on Arbitrum One" and the defined-term name "USDT" is bold
Scroll until section 4.2.4 is visible
Verify the defined-term name "Wallet Inbound Transfers" is bold
Scroll within section 4.2.4 until the warning beginning "Synonym incurs no obligation whatsoever" is visible
Verify the visible warning text is bold
Scroll until the warning ending "All such erroneously transmitted Digital Assets will be lost." is visible
Verify the warning is bold through its final period
Scroll until section 7.2 is visible
Verify the "Synonym Content" caption is bold
Scroll until the final paragraph of section 10 is visible
Verify the sentence beginning "In addition, should your actions" is bold through its final period
Scroll until section 20.6 is visible
Verify the jury-trial waiver caption and its full paragraph are bold
Scroll the terms to the end of section 21
Verify the final "Electronic Communications and Acceptance" caption is bold and the clause is readable through its last sentence
Verify Continue is enabled without selecting a checkbox
Tap Continue
Verify the welcome screen shows Get started and Skip intro (identifiers "GetStarted" and "SkipIntro")
